notes.title: OUR AUGUST PLAYTEST IS LIVE!
notes.content:
Gladiators!

Our August Playtest for Contenders: Arena is LIVE NOW and will run until Sunday, August 13th! WE have worked hard to address feedback from the July session and are excited to share all of the improvements! 

Updates & Improvements:
Ability balancing & Improvements
Weapon balancing & Improvements
Added Heat gain feed
Updated Animations across 3 Gladiators
Added New Weapon Animations
Added User Profile UI
Updated Challenge tracking
HUD Improvements
- Updated Pre-Match and Half-Time screens
Updated Tutorial
- Improved feedback and guiding systems
- Ability to replay Time Trials with all 3 gladiators types
Customization System fixes

Known issues:
Server crashes (we are working on resolving this).
Challenge rewards sometimes do not display upon receiving the reward (It reflects after you exit and re-open the game).
Reconnecting players cause lag spikes
A very rare bug that has a possibility of having 4 players in 1 team.

PLAYTEST TIME
Servers open - Wednesday 9th August at 17:00 CEST (8 AM PDT)
Servers close - Sunday 13th August at 19:00 CEST (11 AM PDT)

Feedback forms will follow after the playtest concludes.

See you in the Arena!

notes.title: The July Playtest is LIVE!
notes.content:
Gladiators!

It is finally time for the July CLOSED Playtest for Contenders: Arena! Access has been granted and the Arena is ready for non-stop action! 

PLAYTEST TIME

Servers open - Friday 14th July at 17:00 CEST (8AM PDT)
Servers close - Sunday 16th July at 19:00 CEST (11AM PDT)

CONFIDENTIALITY
We would like to kindly remind you that the Contenders: Arena Playtest is under strict NDA. Your participation is subjected to your validation of our Non-Disclosure Agreement.

Please DO NOT SHARE, RECORD, or STREAM anything from these sessions – you are under NDA!

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

 New Team Death-Match Level
 Updated Capture The Flag Level
 Updated Main menu UI
 Updated controller scheme
 Updated friends & party system for Steam

Customization System with the following:
Loadouts
 Selecting your Corporation, abilities, and weapon you bring with you to the game
Appearance
 Personalizing your Gladiator with skins
 Selecting a Charm to further make your Gladiator special
 Selecting a Chip companion

Tutorial Level & Tutorial leaderboards
 Added Corporation Armor
 Added Weapon attachment meshes
 3 Melee abilities
 Added hit feedback

New Battle tracks
 Main menu track
 New female announcer
 More crowd reactions


Issues that we know of:
Customization issue where armors are displayed as Pink when in the arena.
Pre-set Loadout system showing after warm up phase

Can’t wait to see you in the Arena!

CONTENDERS

notes.title: Step into the ARENA!
notes.content:
Salutations Gladiators,

We are absolutely psyched to announce our first CLOSED Technical Test for Contenders: Arena, kicking off on Friday 16.06.2023 and running for 3 days straight!

We are accepting 300 players for the first test

PLAYTEST TIME

The Contenders Arena Closed Playtest is live from:

Servers open - Friday 16th June 17:00 CEST (8am PDT)

Servers close - Sunday 18th Junel 19:00 CEST (11am PDT)

So, why should you play Contenders: Arena next weekend?


 The absolutely upgraded Overstep experience
You loved the DIY acrobatic shooter from a hobbyist team. Now come check out how much of a difference a full time team makes.

 Three classes
Yes, we have three classes now! Support, Assault (Hunter) and Tank. The rock, paper, scissors dynamic has added a vast amount of tactics into the game.

 Opportunity to help balance and build the game
We plan to support this game for years to come. Let's work together to make it a balanced and fun experience for both casual and competitive players. 

THE ARENA IS OPEN
For the best experience we recommend playing during these hours:

18:00 - 21:00 CEST

CONFIDENTIALITY

We would like to kindly remind you.

The Contenders Arena Technical Test is under strict NDA. Your participation is subjected to your validation of our Non-Disclosure Agreement.

Please DO NOT SHARE, RECORD, or STREAM anything from these sessions – you are under NDA!

See you in the Arena
CONTENDER
